dict.Documentul e doar pentru citire: macroco: The document is read-only: the macro cannot change anything.
dict.Înregistrează macrocomandă: tot ce scrii: Record Macro: everything you type and format in the document is remembered, so you can repeat it later with one click
dict.Macrocomenzi: pașii înregistrați (text,: Macros: the recorded steps (text, deletions, formatting), repeated with one click from the cursor
dict.Rulează macrocomanda de la cursor: Run the macro from the cursor
dict.Bifat: pașii se repetă de la locul curso: Checked: the steps are repeated from the cursor position when you run it. Unchecked: in exactly the same places in the document.
dict.Documentul nu are încă macrocomenzi. Apa: This document has no macros yet. Press ⏺ Record Macro, do the steps in the document, then ⏹ Stop Recording.
dict.Mută macrocomanda în fișierul acestui do: Move the macro into this document's file (it no longer appears in other documents)
dict.Mută macrocomanda pe acest calculator, c: Move the macro to this computer, so it works in any open document
dict.Pornește de la cursor la rulare: Start from the cursor when running
dict.Rulează pornește de la locul cursorului: Run starts from the cursor position (for macros that start from the cursor). Macros in “this document” are kept in the file, those in “all documents” on this computer, for any open document.
dict.Tot ce scrii, ștergi și formatezi în doc: Everything you type, delete and format in the document from now on is remembered, until you press ⏹ Stop Recording. It starts from the cursor position.
dict.Ce schimbi pe slide de acum se ține mint: What you change on the slide from now on is remembered, until you press ⏹ Stop Recording: the format and text of the selected boxes, moving them, new boxes, the slide background and transition.
dict.Mută macrocomanda în fișierul acestei pr: Move the macro into this presentation’s file (it no longer appears in other presentations)
dict.Mută macrocomanda pe acest calculator, c: Move the macro to this computer, so it works in any open presentation
dict.Prezentarea nu are încă macrocomenzi. Ap: This presentation has no macros yet. Press ⏺ Record Macro, do the steps on the slide, then ⏹ Stop Recording.
dict.Rulează pune pașii pe slide-ul de acum ș: Run applies the steps to the current slide and the boxes selected now. Macros in “this presentation” are kept in the file, those in “all presentations” on this computer, for any open presentation.
dict.Înregistrează macrocomandă: ce schimbi p: Record Macro: what you change on the slide is remembered, so you can repeat it later with one click on another slide or other boxes
dict.Macrocomenzi: pașii înregistrați (format: Macros: the recorded steps (format and text of the selected boxes, moving, new boxes, background), repeated with one click on the current slide
dict.Macrocomenzile merg pe slide-uri, nu pe: Macros work on slides, not on the master: close the master view.
dict.Rulează macrocomanda pe slide-ul de acum: Run the macro on the current slide

templates.Macrocomanda „{0}” n-a fost păstrată: nu: Macro “{0}” was not kept: nothing changed in the document while recording.
templates.Macrocomanda „{0}” nu s-a putut rula aic: Macro “{0}” could not run here: the first step does not fit the document at this place.
templates.Macrocomanda „{0}” s-a oprit la pasul {1: Macro “{0}” stopped at step {1} of {2}: the document is different at this place (Ctrl+Z undoes what was done).
templates.Se înregistrează macrocomanda „{0}”: scr: Recording macro “{0}”: type and format, then View → ⏹ Stop Recording.
templates.Macrocomanda „{0}” e gata ({1}): Vizuali: Macro “{0}” is ready ({1}): View → Macros → ▶ Run.
templates.Macrocomanda „{0}” a rulat pe slide-ul {: Macro “{0}” ran on slide {1} (Ctrl+Z undoes it).
templates.Macrocomanda „{0}” a rulat, dar nicio ca: Macro “{0}” ran, but no box was selected: {1} (Ctrl+Z undoes it).
templates.Macrocomanda „{0}” n-a fost păstrată: nu: Macro “{0}” was not kept: nothing changed on the slide while recording.
templates.Se înregistrează macrocomanda „{0}”: sch: Recording macro “{0}”: change the slide, then View → ⏹ Stop Recording.
